title: Java Site
description: This project allows you to host a website using your minecraft server!
body:
This mod allows you to create your own website, with the only requirement being that you have to write it first!

INSTRUCTIONS:

1. Place the plugin in the plugins file
2. Run the server
3. Stop the sever
4. Edit the config file to set the port to the port you will use for your website (ANY FREE PORT)
5. Set the index file to the name of the index file (usally you'll leave this blank)
6. Upload your website in the same folder as the config
7. Run the server!
8. Your website is now active and you can go check it out!
